'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Stephen Kim LS Kashyyyk Forest Depths''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Kim]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Bluff Wookies. Transcription note: Username "raith" here vs "raitha" on DS p61 — same player; no objective, starts at Kashyyyk: Forest Depths

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kashyyyk: Forest Depths (Virtual Block 6)|Kashyyyk: Forest Depths]]
* '''Username:''' raith
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
